question: What do I bring to my first visit?
expectedResponse: Bring a photo ID and your insurance card, and arrive 15 minutes early to complete registration. Cites the Patient Intake policy.
actualResponse:
For your first visit, please:

- Arrive 15 minutes early to complete registration.
- Bring a photo ID and your insurance card.
- Bring an updated insurance card if your insurance plan has changed.
- If you are under 18, you must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian. [1]

You can complete intake forms in advance through the patient portal or fill them out on a tablet at check-in. The forms include medical history, current medications, allergies, and emergency contact information. [1]

Per the Patient Intake & Registration Policy, if you have questions not covered there, contact the front desk. [1]

question: How many PTO days do new full-time staff get, and when can I use them?
expectedResponse: 12 PTO days per year, accrued monthly from day one, but PTO cannot be used during the first 90 days. Cites the Staff Handbook.
actualResponse:
Per the Staff Handbook, new full-time staff receive 12 PTO days per year, accrued monthly. PTO starts accruing from day one of employment, but it cannot be used during the first 90 days. After 3 years of employment, the PTO allowance increases to 18 days per year. [1]

Per clinic policy, staff policy questions should be directed to the Practice Manager if you need more details. [1]
